policy: Exploratory eight-star pilot from completed original below-threshold records only. Require at least2 unopened additional sectors<=55, at most9 total early sectors, and unopened original reserved sectors. Rank original maximum SNR descending then TIC. Use the original strongest peak as the sole local-refinement seed; add all early sectors with unchanged local refinement at1.5/2.5day detrending. Review flag only if both local formal SNR>=8, periods agree within0.5%, and neither profile hits its search boundary. This is NOT original full-gate passage, calibrated significance or blind full-domain rediscovery. Preserve failures; no reserved sector is opened.
